sources.title: Spiritual Machines: The Merging of Man and Machine — Ray Kurzweil

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: More than half of learning is supplied by intelligent simulated teachers, rather than human instruction or ordinary learning resources.
reference.rationale: 2019 classroom and distance learning did not predominantly use intelligent simulated teachers. AI tutoring is a growing capability, but teacher-based education and other learning remain central. A video lecture or web page is not automatically an intelligent tutor.
